items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Miles Davis fooled around with one of those for a while.

ctx.x: I think that's what would make me go into retirement quicker than anything else, Jimmy.

Well, I think if I had to put one of those microphones in my mouthpiece, play that way, I would give up. It's the same thing because, you know, they've got dials that can make your tone an octave lower or you can get an octave higher at the same time, or you can get a buzz in it. Miles Davis fooled around with one of those for a while.
